rows.name: Boise Bench Generation Project
rows.quote: The Boise Bench BESS Generation Project (BOBS) at the existing Boise Bench 138 kV substation located near Boise, ID is a 200 MW inverter-based battery generation resource.

rows.name: Oxbow Switch Yard T233 Transformer Replacement Project
rows.quote: This transformer will be upgraded with a larger 200 MVA 230kV/138kV transformer to better serve growing load and system transfers through the underlying 138k and 69kV system. This project is intended to improve system performance to the West Central Mountains local area of the system and has no significant impact to the WECC Interconnected electric system. The planned in-service date Spring 2026.

rows.name: Horseflat T232 Transformer Project
rows.quote: Horseflat substation will install the previous Oxbow 230/138kV transformer as a new T232 that has a 100 MVA rating.

rows.name: Pronghorn 230/138/161 Substation Project
rows.quote: Pronghorn substation will be a new 230/161/138kV switching station to better serve load from the existing 230kV and 161 kV and 138kV system located in Butte County, ID.

rows.name: Crimson Orchard Generation Project
rows.quote: The Crimson Orchard Solar and BESS Generation Project (CRIM) at the existing Danskin 230 kV substation located near Elmore, ID is a 100 MW inverter-based battery generation resource and a 100 MW inverter-based solar generation resource for a comined point of injection of 100 MW max output.

rows.name: Blacks Creek Substation
rows.quote: The new Blacks Creek substation (BKSR) is being built south of Boise, ID to interconnect the Blacks Creek Generation Project. The BKSR substation will be fed by splitting the existing 13 mile Chip-Hubbard 230 kV transmission line and building approximately 1 mile of new 230 kV transmission to the new BSKR substation.

rows.name: Blacks Creek Generation Project
rows.quote: The Blacks Creek Generation project is a 400 MW inverter-based solar generation resource. The new generation is in proximity to Idaho Power’s main load center and will serve Idaho Power native load. The project was studied during the generation interconnection process and has no significant impact on the WECC interconnected electric system. The planned in-service date of end of 2027.

rows.name: Boardman to Hemingway Transmission Project
rows.quote: The Boardman to Hemingway Transmission Line Project (B2H) is a planned 500-kilovolt (kV) transmission project that would span between the Hemingway 500-kV substation near Melba, Idaho, and the Longhorn Substation near Boardman, Oregon.

rows.name: Hemingway 500 kV Line Terminal with Shunt Reactors and Series Capacitor
rows.quote: Hemingway 500 kV Line Terminal with Shunt Reactors and Series Capacitor

rows.name: Gateway West Transmission Project
rows.quote: Idaho Power and PacifiCorp are pursuing the joint development of the Gateway West project, a high-voltage transmission line project between a substation located near Douglas, Wyoming, and the Hemingway substation located near Boise, Idaho.

rows.name: GWW Second Midpoint-Hemingway
rows.quote: Current permitting and pre-construction activities are focused on the section of line between Hemingway and Midpoint substations. Idaho Power expects the in-service date for this section of line, or a portion of this section, will be 2028 or later.

rows.name: Mayfield (MYFD) 500kV substation
rows.quote: A new 500kV substation MYFD has been proposed by Idaho Power to connect on the second 500kV circuit from Midpoint to Hemingway Gateway West Section. The resulting lines will be an approximate 36 mile Hemingway-Mayfield 500kV, and an approximate 90 mile Mayfiled-Mipoint 500kV line.

rows.name: Loop in of existing Chip-Rattlesnake 230 kV line
rows.quote: Loop in of existing Chip-Rattlesnake 230 kV line  Chip-Mayfield 230 kV line, approx.16 miles  Mayfield-Rattlesnake 230 kV line, approx.21 miles

rows.name: Pleasant Valley – Mayfield 230kV line
rows.quote: Pleasant Valley – Mayfield 230kV line, approx. 6 miles
